keeps.name: Robinson Creek South Campground
keeps.waterfront_evidence: Esri+NAIP imagery with rec.gov 233102 per-site coords and the OSM Robinson Creek line at 38.1836,-119.3215: RV pads 001-004 (west loop edge) and 022 (east) 15-19 m from the creek centreline in the same open-pine stand, no road or developed strip between; creek (~5-10 m wide) loops around the south loop; rec.gov: 'Robinson Creek ... can be easily accessed from within the campground.'
keeps.inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 233102 campsite catalog (read 2026-10-26): 14 STANDARD + 3 RV NONELECTRIC drive-in sites (plus 1 tent and 7 walk-to); 16 take a 23-ft motorhome (Max Vehicle Length 25-40 ft; 007 is 20 ft); Humboldt-Toiyabe NF page lists Robinson Creek South and North.
keeps.note: Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest (Bridgeport Ranger District) campground on Robinson Creek at about 7,000 ft, 9.3 miles up Twin Lakes Road from US-395 in Bridgeport, beside Robinson Creek North; concessionaire-run (Westrek). Jeffrey and lodgepole pine; sites 10-16 are walk-to tent sites and 8 is tent-only. Bears frequent the area. --Claude

facilities.note: recreation.gov says 'Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided'; the Forest Service page lists 'Flush toilet(s)'. The two official pages disagree on the toilets.

booking.note: recreation.gov rules: maxStay 14 (Rolling 30 Days), minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4. Forest Service: 'Reservations are available during the peak season (mid-May to early-September).' Outside the peak season the sites are first-come. Sites 001, 005, 024 and 025 are not reservable. recreation.gov's 2026 peak (reservation) season ran 05-15 to 09-07; 2027's runs 05-14 to 09-07.

season.note: Forest Service (both loops): 'Late April - early October, as weather and conditions allow.' The dates are recreation.gov's 2026 fee seasons for this loop (Peak 05-15..09-07, Off Peak and first-come to 09-19).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233102: Max Vehicle Length 25-40 on the 16 standard/RV sites that take 23 ft (RV equipment max_length 40 on 006/019), 20 on 007; Driveway Entry 'Pull-Through' on 005 (25 ft)

adds.name: Robinson Creek North Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Esri imagery with rec.gov 232090 per-site coords and the OSM Robinson Creek line at 38.1856,-119.3206: RV pads 037 (10 m) and 035 (19 m) from the creek centreline, 044/045/036 26-33 m, along the riparian edge on the loop's east side with no road between (rec.gov site map draws 36-43 beside the creek); creek ~5-10 m wide; rec.gov: 'situated alongside its namesake creek'.
adds.inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 232090 campsite catalog (read 2026-10-26): 29 STANDARD NONELECTRIC drive-in sites (27 single, 2 double); 28 take a 23-ft motorhome (Max Vehicle Length 25-40 ft; 031 lists 0, a catalogue placeholder); Humboldt-Toiyabe NF page lists Robinson Creek South and North.
adds.note: Humboldt-Toiyabe National Forest (Bridgeport Ranger District) campground on Robinson Creek at about 7,000 ft, 9.3 miles up Twin Lakes Road from US-395 in Bridgeport, the upstream loop beside Robinson Creek South; concessionaire-run (Westrek). Jeffrey and lodgepole pine; most sites are first-come, a few reservable in summer. Bears frequent the area. --Claude

facilities.note: recreation.gov says 'Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided'; the Forest Service page lists 'Flush toilet(s)'. The two official pages disagree on the toilets.

booking.note: recreation.gov rules: maxStay 14 (Rolling 30 Days), minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4. Only 8 sites are reservable (027, 028, 030, 032-036); the other 21 are first-come all season. recreation.gov: 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites as well as reservation sites.'
